issues.issue: Survival figure '41 of 62 (67%)' for SEDs conflicts with the trial N of 50 SED patients stated in pivotal_trials[0].n, an internal inconsistency in denominators.
False-positive uncited_numbers flags (91, 10, 10, 1) are the trial identifier 'CAC-91-10-10' and should be excluded as a study ID.
False-positive uncited_numbers flags (2882, 2882, 1) are PMR/PMC identifiers '2882-1' and '2882-2' and should be excluded as study/requirement IDs.

The 'Most common adverse reactions (≥1%)' quote is attributed to line 18 of the label doc, the same line cited elsewhere for the trial protocol description, suggesting a possible line mislabel (content is otherwise a valid safety statement).
